selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What big truth is found in the work being done in the heavens?
questions.answer: It shows that the heavens are under control, care, order, cleaning, turning, and use.

questions.question: What does this truth tell us about the Creator of the heavens?
questions.answer: It shows that the Creator surely exists and is One.

questions.question: How clear is this proof said to be?
questions.answer: It is even clearer than the heavens themselves.

questions.question: Name two parts of the heavenly work named in the passage.
questions.answer: Ordering and cleansing.

questions.question: Is this truth hidden or able to be noticed?
questions.answer: It can be observed.

questions.question: What is the main idea of this passage?
questions.answer: The heavens show clear signs of Allah’s existence and unity.

questions.question: What kinds of actions are joined together in the truth mentioned here?
questions.answer: Bringing things under command, managing, turning, arranging, cleaning, and giving jobs.

questions.question: What does “unity” mean here?
questions.answer: That there is only one true Creator.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the size and reach of this heavenly work?
questions.answer: It is very great and covers everything broadly.

questions.question: According to the passage, is this truth weak and incomplete or vast and perfect?
questions.answer: Vast and perfect.

questions.question: Where does the passage say this witness can be seen?
questions.answer: In the heavens and in all they contain.

questions.question: What is being testified to in this passage?
questions.answer: The necessary existence and oneness of the Creator.

questions.question: What kind of Being is Allah called in the statement at the end?
questions.answer: The One whose existence is necessary.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention grandeur and comprehensiveness?
questions.answer: To show that this truth is vast and mighty.

questions.question: Do the heavens witness by words or by the way they are run?
questions.answer: By the way they are run.

questions.question: What six parts are included in the truth named in the passage?
questions.answer: Subjugation, administration, revolution, ordering, cleansing, and employment.

questions.question: What do these six parts together bear witness to?
questions.answer: They bear witness to the Creator’s sure existence and unity.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the heavens as a proof?
questions.answer: They are a strong sign pointing to Allah.

questions.question: What is one reason the witness of the heavens is convincing?
questions.answer: The order and control in them can be seen.

questions.question: What short belief statement matches the meaning of the passage?
questions.answer: There is no god but Allah.

questions.question: What can a reader learn by looking at the heavens in this passage?
questions.answer: That Allah exists and is One.

questions.question: What does “necessary existence” mean in a simple way?
questions.answer: That Allah truly must exist.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the truth found in the heavens: small or wide?
questions.answer: Wide.

questions.question: Why is the truth called comprehensive?
questions.answer: Because it includes many kinds of work all together.
